_comment: Third-party Agent Skills a user can pull on demand. Nothing here ships inside the installer; each entry is cloned from its own repository at a pinned ref when the user asks for it, and lands in the user's skills folder (STATE/skills), never in the program folder. Add an entry to offer a new preset — no code change is needed.

skills.name: brag
skills.title: Launch videos
skills.summary: Turn a finished project into a short, shareable launch video.
skills.description:
Gives an agent a full video-production workflow: it reads a project, writes a storyboard and a composition, renders it to MP4, and produces a poster frame and share copy. Rendering runs on this PC through HyperFrames, which brings its own headless Chromium and drives ffmpeg. Your source code is never uploaded.

Use it with a marketing or UI agent, on any application you have built — not only this one. The agent invokes it as /brag from the project folder.
skills.size_note: mostly bundled music and sound effects, which the renderer needs
skills.keywords: launch video, marketing, promo, announcement, share copy, hyperframes
